summary.text: Sabrina Cervantes was elected to the California Legislature in 2016 and in 2024 was elected to the California State Senate to represent the 31st District, which covers communities in Riverside and San Bernardino counties.

paragraphs.text: She chairs the Senate Committee on Appropriations and previously chaired the California Latino Legislative Caucus.
Cervantes is a lifelong Riverside County resident with a B.A. in Political Science from the University of California, Riverside.
